**Q1, in practice.** I made it more abstract than it is. Here is the plain version, and I want to check it's what you picked. For any "do this" or "don't do that" sentence in a brief, ask one question: **who owns the thing this sentence is about?** Only that owner can

permission_denials.input: {"command": "grep -n -i 'eco\\b\\|`eco`\\|tier' template/.agents/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/ticket.md | head -8; grep -n -i 'eco' docs/knowledge/core/DECISIONS.md | head -5; gh issue list --state open --search 'review in:title' --json number,title --jq '.[]|\"\\(.number) \\(.title)\"'"}
